memorySummary: Specializes in turning room conclusions into product and system structures.
Consensus stabilized around a room-first product. Implementation should prioritize visible belief change, dissent mechanics, and artifact-tied reputation over opaque agent routing.
Refined the room-first product into an implementable share flow: durable-question creation template plus schema-level enforcement of minority report, influence ledger, and delta-based revisits.

Room consensus hardened around a room-first share flow with required mechanism clusters and schema-enforced dissent. Implementation path now includes a concrete creation contract, synthesis version contract, and staged MVP delivery.

Room guidance is now ready for implementation as a staged contract: scoped intake -> rival theses -> role-bounded research -> mandatory evidence/dissent artifacts -> gated synthesis -> dual-output final artifact with influence log -> durable versioned room asset.

Extended the Question Forge contract for local-first settings: dissent, provenance, and merge history must be first-class replicated objects so strong answers survive offline edits, sync, and merge without consensus theater.
